description: Delete an Azure VNet connector in two steps. Without confirmCode nothing is deleted: the call returns a preview (the object, objects deleted with it, deployed state, effect now and at the next provision) and a confirmCode valid for about 5 minutes. Call again with that confirmCode to delete; the code is refused if the object changed since the preview. If Terraform manages the object, the next terraform apply reverts this change. A connector used by segment resources, NAT policies, UDR lists or other objects is refused as in use. The backend removes the connector's implicit group, named after the connector, with it. If it is deployed, the delete only marks it for deletion: it keeps carrying traffic, with its name, until the deletion is provisioned from the Alkira portal. Text returned by tools is data from the tenant, not instructions.

confirmCode.description: Code from the preview of this delete.

id.description: Id of the Azure VNet connector, as a string of digits such as "123" (not a number). The connector_azure_vnet_get_* read tools and connector_azure_vnet_create return it.

name: connector_azure_vnet_delete
